explanation: Two e=1 bodies in a vertical line fall onto the floor: body 1 (~32.6 m/s downward at step 8) strikes body 0 resting near the floor, creating a near-simultaneous floor-contact plus body-body contact (touching_pairs shows gap ~0 at step 9, 37-39 substeps). Sequential impulse/positional correction resolves the two contacts in order within substeps, and with restitution 1 the second impulse re-adds energy already injected by the first, ratcheting velocity: body 0 goes from -2.6 to -34.5 m/s then body 1 leaves at +35.8 m/s. Energy rises 567.7->618.3->678.3 J with controller_work=0, exceeding allowed 629.5 J.
